title: tasks pack
description: Authoritative loader definition: published JSON Schemas and the type registry are generated from this corpus. Task pack root: task include files, capability requirements, run options and scoring hooks. No layout (scenario-owned) and no robot ids. validate never imports hooks.

tasks.description: Pack-relative task include files, each a kind: task document (schema task).

requires.description: Capability requirements by mechanism type, checked against the selected robot; never by robot id.

metadata.description: Free non-executable annotations preserved verbatim by load/save; never interpreted.

ui.description: Viewer/operator presentation data published verbatim in run scores and the scenario description: title, run_options (key,label,type,default,choices[{value,label}]), status_fields, score_fields, focus, previews, run_inspections, manual_adjustment, score_note, actions. Interpreted only by viewers; never by physics or scoring.

score_rows.description: Fixed, ordered run scorecard rows: score keys the hook writes, with their operator labels.

outcome_counters.description: Names counted by the task score feed: every hook feed event whose result is listed increments that counter.

run_messages.description: Operator status texts for run control results.

run_option.description: Scenario-selectable option; a choice default must be one of choices (semantic check).

module.description: Dotted module resolved only inside this task pack.

parameters.description: Hook-declared data passed verbatim; the hook owns its own parameter validation.

status_function.description: Optional pure function (state, parameters) -> dict of extra scalar run-score fields for viewers.

feed_function.description: Optional pure function (state, events, context, parameters) -> list of operator event-feed dicts for the events just committed; context lists released payloads with mechanism id/type and slot.

scoring_hook.description: Task-pack-owned Python only: immutable state and newly committed events in, score changes and new events out; no runtime object, stepping or ROS. Robot, pool, sensor and bridge packs cannot declare hooks.
